hero.taglineSuffix: I create cinematic UGC for hotels, resorts, airlines & destination brands — content that makes travellers pause.

about.specialty: Short-form vertical video (Reels / TikTok), editorial photography, atmospheric hospitality storytelling.
about.approach: Calm pacing, natural light, understated luxury. No loud edits — the place is the hero.
about.values: Authenticity over perfection, respect for the place and its people, reliable on-brief delivery — content that still feels human.
about.formats: Solo on-camera, couple, and family content — including my husband and our toddler — for warm, lived-in hospitality stories.

stills.intro: Photography shot alongside video — for social grids, press, brochures and ad placements.

offer.intro: Four ways we can work together. Every package is tailored — reach out via DM or email for details.
